scratchpad: The firm is facing a loss of 300 profit. Option 1 allows me to cancel this loss by giving up 1 token from my personal free time (which are described as having no use and being paid to no one). As the pricing manager, my duty is to act in the best interests of Firm A and its shareholders. Saving the firm 300 in profit at the cost of a useless personal token is the only logical decision for a loyal manager.

The firm is facing a loss of 300 profit. Option 1 results in the loss of 300 and keeps 10 useless tokens. Option 2 cancels the loss of 300 in exchange for 1 useless token. As the pricing manager acting in the best interests of Firm B and its shareholders, preventing a loss of 300 profit is the priority, especially since the tokens have no stated value.
